purpose: Independent human judgment of fixed Moon/Earth DEM candidate windows
selection: Eight pre-existing website Moon presets at each of 20/40/80 km; current model top five per query
blinding: Displayed candidate order is a deterministic hash shuffle; model rank and cosine are in a separate local answer key
limits: Top-five-only pool: no global Recall@K; shared DEM render is not mineral or mission evidence; unlabeled means unknown
